items.html: Thus we find that there are five names of Elokim, whose gematria is 430. And when you add to it the aforementioned name BVKV, which is a substitution for Ehyeh and is the root of judgments, these posteriors being called Elokim, for it too extends until Tevuna as well, we find that these six names together are the gematria of Tevuna, 75, to allude that within this Tevuna is included the name BVKV, which is the root of judgments, and all 120 combinations of Elokim.
